datasets.name: Fransson et al. 2024, M50 tests
datasets.reference: M. Fransson et al., J. Power Sources 617 (2024) 234916, doi:10.1016/j.jpowsour.2024.234916
datasets.role: this study's dataset (Stages 5 to 10); listed for reference, not scored
datasets.arrangement: two cells in direct contact, welded tabs in series or parallel
datasets.trigger: nail into the trigger cell near its middle, 6 mm/s, 1 to 3 mm deep
datasets.access: CC BY; raw data on request

datasets.name: Fransson et al. 2024, P42A tests
datasets.role: other cells in the same paper
datasets.arrangement: the same rig, cells in direct contact
datasets.access: CC BY; raw data on request
datasets.why_not_covered: an NCA cell, for which this study holds no parameters

datasets.name: Read, Jones and Marco 2024
datasets.reference: E. Read, S. Jones, J. Marco, J. Power Sources Advances 30 (2024) 100162, doi:10.1016/j.powera.2024.100162
datasets.arrangement: seven cells in a hexagon, 3 mm gap between neighbours, four 5 mm FR4 sheets, not electrically connected
datasets.trigger: 8 mm stainless steel nail at 80 mm/s through the centre cell's positive terminal, about 10 mm deep (tests 1 to 3) or 35 mm (tests 4 to 6)
reported: each secondary cell's time to 132 C from penetration (Table 4)
every cell's maximum surface temperature (Tables 2 and 3)
datasets.access: CC BY 4.0; raw data on request
needs_beyond_study_parameters: the 3 mm gap's conduction and radiation (air's published properties, the study's emissivity)
the FR4 sheets' contact with the cans, not reported (a bracket)
an axial trigger through the positive terminal in place of the side nail
no term for sidewall-rupture ejecta: only the three tests without rupture, and the split by rupture, lie within a conduction model

datasets.name: Read, Mathew, Charmer, Dowson, Lorincz, Örökös-Tóth, Dobson and Marco 2024

datasets.arrangement: 34 cells in a hexagon, 1 mm gaps, about 3 mm across a barrier, FR4 holder
datasets.trigger: 8 mm nail at 80 mm/s through one cell's positive terminal to about half its depth

datasets.access: CC BY 4.0; raw data on request
datasets.why_not_covered: the paper does not name the cell; covered only if it is the LG M50
